native_context_entries.scope: Read while investigating the excluded full-state portable-drop candidate; actual ordinary drops are subsequently cleaned by mod CoverDropMixin.

excluded_candidates: Ordinary generator drops do not retain full running/fluid state after configured CoverDropMixin -> CoverDrops.capture; both steam and gas inherit GTEnergyBlockEntity and are not one of its tank exceptions.
No automatic exhaust pushing promised by original; bottom-layer extraction exists on both.
Original FL.steam is the named steam identity, not anysteam; no unsupported steam-alias regression asserted.
Original leftover input clearing and unchecked fluid fill/set risks are not automatically restored; current preflight/conservation policy is recorded.
Mixin fallback cover host exists; declared Java interfaces alone cannot prove cover or control installation absent.
provenance: Read-only GregTech-6 Team original sources: turbine/base converter headers 2025, gas/converter behavior 2023, capacitor Gregorius Techneticies 2019; each source keeps its own LGPL-3.0-or-later notice. No original method bodies or native sources newly copied into production.
limitations: No Java target initialization/compilation, Gradle, tests, game, actual fuel injection/transfer, structure build, rendering, world restart, overloaded plant or build/push.

Finite source arithmetic and coordinates do not prove runtime worlds, optional fuel registration, native callback ordering under external interception, all custom fluids, full recipe equivalence or performance.
No actual addon or modpack incident is claimed; policy items require an explicit design decision before behavioral edits.
